text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
How cruel that the race with the greatest
history, tradition, and
renown can only be
entered once in a runner's life.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Many famed racers have suffered defeat in
the face of their
dream—the dream of
every Umamusume—to reach the pinnacle
of
racing and become Derby champion.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
On that day, an astounding 200,000 fans
watched as the gates
opened.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
In the Derby, it's no easy feat to take an
early lead and keep it. But
the runner in
pink insisted on doing it her own way.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
What unfolded was not a race to outrun
the rest. It was a high-speed
war of
attrition.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
She'd barely shaken off her opponents
when she crossed the finish
line. Her body
exhausted, she hadn't the energy left for
one more
step.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Her only way to win was to put every
ounce of her being into it.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The champion's name was Ines Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The roaring applause that echoed
throughout the racecourse in Fuchu
that
day still resounds in the mind of every fan.
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's the final straight! Which racer has what
it takes to stand
victorious?!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You can do iiit!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wooow! They're all so fast!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The leader has a burst of speed! Now, the
runner in second place
advances from the
opposite side of the pack!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah! The girl in front is gonna lose the lead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And she takes the lead! Just like that, she
pushes ahead! She widens
the gap
between herself and her rival!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Oh no, I feel so bad for her...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Look, she hasn't given up yet. So you
shouldn't give up either. Why
don't you
keep cheering her on?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sob... You can do it! Keep going!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's going all the way! There's the finish!
She bested her rivals,
taking the crown in a
stunning victory!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Awww, she lost... She's crying...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's sad after she ran so well. But look,
the winner's crying too.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You're right... Why?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume's Mother
text_block_list.text:
The Derby is the dream of every one of
these racers.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume's Mother
text_block_list.text:
So whether they win or lose, they'll cry.
Because they gave it their
very all to make
their dream come true. They worked so
hard for this.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Dream... Derby...

At Tracen Academy, the swelteringly hot
days are beginning to cool
down.

And the academy's annual autumn event,
the Solefall Faire, is almost
here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right! Landed a cabbage supplier!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Cabbage? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The Solefall Faire, you ding-dong! I've
been planning to sell my
special Golshi
yakisoba there since forever ago!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And I need you and our trusty trainer to
pitch in. You'd better start
practicing your
griddle skills.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I don't like the sound of this at all... I'll
have you taste it first, Trainer.
Someone
needs to check if it's safe.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry your pretty face. I'm not
gonna use anything inedible.
Just
cabbage, carrots, wasabi paste, grated
wasabi, and diced wasabi.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: How much wasabi are you using?!

The whole academy is frantically preparing
for the festival. In the
midst of all the
uproar, someone comes to see me.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: There you are.

Tazuna Hayakawa, assistant to the director
of Tracen, approaches
with a big smile.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I have big news. ♪ Your predecessor is
being given an award by the
URA.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
An award? For what? Getting a kitten out
of a tree?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Don't you know? It's an honor given to
racers and trainers who've
made
outstanding achievements.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Some make it their mission to get it.
Winners get their photo and race
record
displayed in the Umamusume Museum at
the Tokyo
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And who more fitting than him? Oguri's
final race is still a favorite
among fans.

It's not just the fans. Mejiro McQueen and
I will never forget that
Arima Kinen run
either.

It's not just the fans. Mejiro McQueen and
I will never forget that
Arima Kinen run
either.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
My mentor really was out of this world.
Truly amazing.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The awards ceremony will be broadcast
live, so don't miss it!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In other matters, I have a small favor to
ask...

Tazuna directs me to the academy library,
where I've been asked to
help a student
prepare something for the Solefall Faire.
Waaaaah! I'm gonna CRY!
No matter how many defeats or injuries, she kept on running. This racer had SO much heart. Sob...

Her voice shatters the silence of the
library. With no one else around,
I know
who it is I'm supposed to assist.

Ah! Are you the trainer Ms. Tazuna was
talking about? Thank
goodneeess! Finally
some help! I'm SAVED!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait... I didn't introduce myself! Nice to
meet ya! I'm Winning Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Really though, I volunteered 'cause I had
this rad idea, but now that
I'm in the thick
of prepping, I can't manage at all.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Straight to the point! I need to make
displays for a Derby history
exhibit!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna display it all! The passion and
excitement of each and
every racer who
took on the Derby, with no details left out!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Like this racer who sprinted into first place from way outside! After all the hard work it took to reach the Derby, it's like she knew that was her moment!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And this one—she took a huge lead right from the start, kept it all the way to the end and took first! It's super hard to pull off a win like that, but she knew she could do it. Sob...

The Derby is a prestigious race, and it's
often thought to be the top
event of the
Twinkle Series.

Some people even think the year begins
and ends with it. It's
definitely a big deal.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The Derby really is the best! Yeeeah! I
wanna be Derby champiooon!

Her eyes tear up as she talks. She must
really love it...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for staying so late! When it comes
to the Derby, I just get so
pumped up, you
know?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No problem. It's super interesting. It's
really special for you, huh?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No problem. It's super interesting. It's
really special for you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! The Derby's my dream!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna enter someday and win it! It's my
dream to stand among the
greats and
make my own amazing story!

Looking at the excited racer as she cries
with emotion, it's hard to
believe how she
can be so breathtakingly earnest.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well, first I need to be scouted to do it.
And it's gotta be a trainer
who can take
me all the way there!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I have to focus on the exhibit! We
can't fail if we work
together!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And you know, you can call me Tickezo.
Easier than saying my full
name, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Thanks, Trainer!

Who knows whether she can get into the
Derby, let alone win it?

But one thing's for sure. Her chasing that
purehearted dream is a story
I'd love to
watch unfold.
